drafted_from: tool:run-a-typescript-program-with-no-build's own row (its words, input schema, sample run) and the do-work/echo.ts program it runs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Show me a TypeScript tool program runs with no build." The AI runs tool:run-a-typescript-program-with-no-build with {"words": "typed and run"}, and it answers {"words": "typed and run", "node": "v26.13.0", "types_stripped": true}.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes words, answers them with the Node version that ran it, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run tool:run-a-typescript-program-with-no-build" and give it words, for example "typed and run".
2. Read node in the answer: it is the version of the engine's own Node that started do-work/echo.ts, for example v26.13.0.
3. Read types_stripped: true means that Node strips TypeScript types itself, so any tool's program may be a .ts file with nothing built.

worked_examples.title: A TypeScript program answers on the engine's Node
worked_examples.ask: Check that a TypeScript tool runs on this computer with no build.
